summary: This directory provides a set of utility functions and specialized data structures designed for manipulating collections and complex mappings, facilitating the management of key-value pairs where keys may map to multiple values.
responsibilities: Provide specialized data structures for multi-value mapping
relationships: The MultiMap utility extends standard map functionality by allowing multiple values to be associated with a single key.
Mapping utilities enable consistent transformation of values across standard object collections.
designDecisions: Modularizing collection operations to promote reusability
Encapsulating complex map manipulation to abstract away internal structure initialization
Providing functional mapping utilities for object property transformation
